environment.description: Ktor microservice deployed on ECS Fargate in VPC subnet with direct PostgreSQL RDS connectivity. ALB forwards all traffic to the service with no request inspection. The PostgreSQL role 'app_user' has SELECT/INSERT on all tables in the 'orders' schema. No query parameterization middleware. Service mesh (Envoy sidecar) handles mTLS but performs no payload inspection. X-Tenant-Id header is set by the caller with no upstream validation.

config.database: RDS PostgreSQL 15, role app_user with GRANT SELECT, INSERT ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA public
config.network: ALB -> Target Group (port 8080), no WAF attached
config.auth: X-Tenant-Id header passed through from API Gateway with no claim validation
config.sidecar: Envoy 1.28 with mTLS only, no ext_authz filter
